title: Parent-packet review retention: follow-up Lows (polling retries, untrimmed explicit-read parent, races, HEAD, gate boundaries)
outcome: The follow-up Lows from w-b18b11972c44's review rounds are resolved or explicitly ruled. (e) A terminal reviewer whose retention keeps failing is not fully retried on every packet poll. (1) The explicit attempt-only read (resolve_review_selection) passes the canonical parent id to retention, so a whitespace-padded parent cannot write custody that canonical reads reject; this is the pre-existing twin of the packet-path fix. (2) A follow-up confirming between the packet's discovery and its terminal check no longer serves an old snapshot without its locator or makes a retry 409. (3) A HEAD request to the result endpoint publishes nothing, since axum dispatches HEAD to the GET handler. (4) The terminal-gate boundaries (a Failed attempt, a non-current attempt, storage disabled) have behavioural tests.
acceptance: Repeated parent packet reads of a terminal reviewer whose retention fails persistently do not run a full retention or capture on every read; the retry policy is bounded and documented, and retainedReviewAttemptsError still reports the failure. Shown by a behavioural test with deterministic counts, not timing.
An explicit attempt-only read with a whitespace-padded parent id writes custody only under the canonical parent; a later canonical read and follow-up retention succeed. Shown by a behavioural test.

A follow-up that confirms between the packet's discovery and its terminal check yields a packet that lists the confirmed identity or reports a clear error, never an unlocatable old snapshot, and a retry does not 409. Shown by a deterministic interleaving test.
A HEAD request to the delegation result endpoint makes no custody write. Shown by a behavioural test.
The packet path's terminal gate is covered by behavioural tests for a Failed attempt, a non-current attempt and storage disabled.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
